key_catalyst: Alphabet shares fell more than 4% after raising full-year capital-expenditure guidance to $195–205 billion despite beating Q2 estimates.
reasoning: Alphabet's post-earnings selloff despite strong results makes AI-capex return skepticism an active, high-severity catalyst rather than an earnings risk merely awaiting resolution. That shock is compounded by Tesla's deterioration and an escalating oil-and-rate threat, while the pre-market decline indicates only partial absorption of risks that remain unresolved.
